text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Satono Diamond is running great...!
She definitely lives up to her high rating!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She showed an unbelievable level of composure for a debut race.
We can definitely expect great things from her moving forward!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I hope she can win a GⅠ too!!
And break the "Satono jinx"...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I've finally debuted!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Now that I've finished running, it's finally starting to sink in.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"The cheers from everyone heard during the race...
The pressure and heavy breaths from the other girls.
The tension piercing my skin..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It was an atmosphere unlike anything I've ever felt before. So this is what an actual race is like...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san, Kita-chan too...
They both ran while feeling this kind of atmosphere...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm finally on the same turf, too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond displays her sheer excitement.
That shows just how much this debut means to her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...I will sprint with these legs and win. And win again.
I will fulfill the Satono family's cherished dream no matter what!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Carried along by the flow of spectators heading home, we slowly made our way from the racecourse toward the station.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: That Satono Diamond girl ran so beautifully, didn't she? You know, from the 500-million-point showdown!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Looked like she had a killer late-stage burst, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Don't you think she'll be running in GⅠ races soon? She might even aim for the Japan Derby!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Come to think of it, does the Satono Group
have any Umamusume who've won a GⅠ...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: There aren't any, actually. Satono horse girls used to race quite a bit in the past, but none of them ever won a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That's why magazines write stuff like,
"Still No G1 Umamusume: The Satono Jinx" and all that...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, so there's a rumor like that.
Like a jinx keeping them from winning a GⅠ?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Satono Diamond is the first Satono Umamusume
in quite a while, so I really hope she can win a GI.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to the conversation of the people walking ahead of us,
I cast a brief glance over at Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'll be the one to break that jinx!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond smiled brightly
and struck an enthusiastic, pumped-up pose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her unwavering inner strength, she'll surely
blow away any unsettling rumors and jinxes.
